methodology_explanation: Missing sensor values were median-imputed using training data and missingness indicators were retained. Engineering features including V×I and sensor-difference features were evaluated. Gradient Boosting was selected for Reference Parameter prediction using 5-fold cross-validation with MAE, while a class-balanced Random Forest was used for Valid/Invalid classification with stratified cross-validation and F1-score. Invalid probability, sensor inconsistency and missingness were combined to rank tests requiring attention. The final pipeline performs preprocessing, feature generation, model training, prediction and summary generation automatically.
